records.source_excerpt: Despite being sent off for two bookable offences in Chelsea's defeat to Tottenham Hotspur, and receiving an automatic one-match suspension, Cole Palmer will not miss any Premier League matches. Instead, he will serve his suspension when Chelsea visit Liverpool in the fourth round of the EFL Cup on Wednesday.
records.description: Én kamps karantæne for to gule kort. Afsones mod Liverpool i EFL Cup. Ifølge Premier League misser Palmer ingen Premier League-kampe som følge af denne udvisning.
